description: Reviewed R1 seat slot manifest (owner D1, R18). Each seat names its fixed secrets in the protected cross-cli-seats environment: the canonical SEAT_<CLI>_<SLOT>, the rotation candidate SEAT_CANDIDATE_<CLI>_<SLOT>, and the runtime projection SEAT_USE_<CLI>_<SLOT> the campaign lane loads. One slot per seated family. Gemini holds no slot: it runs through the agy seat (cloud-code tuple). Vibe holds no slot yet (not covered in R). Bundle seatRef must equal seatId.
